notes: Hoarded 20-31 credits clicking for credits from turn 3 to 14 and never installed a card; repeated R&D runs on turns 1-2 kept seeing the same top card. Never ran the naked remotes (Servers 6, 8, 12, 13) or the advancing Server 9, and ran into Wraparound (T8) and IP Block twice (T12) with no breakers.

Strong combo on T7: AstroScript plus SanSan fast-scored Breaking News, then Closed Accounts wiped the tagged Runner's 18 credits. Small issues: R&D was unprotected on T1-2 (Breaking News stolen), and two Sensie Actors Union draws on T10 forced 3 discards.

From T5 to T15 it ran Archives 3-4 times a turn to re-access an Obokata Protocol it always declined to steal, which burned all its credits and grip (Anemone net damage on T12-15 at 0 credits). It never pressured HQ, R&D or the Server 4/5 remotes where Obokata and both Send a Messages were scored.
Scored Hostile Takeover on T1 for money, then punished the Runner's Account Siphon tags and 1-card grip with a lethal Scorched Earth on T2.

Good aggressive HQ/R&D pressure with Aumakua and Paperclip won the game. However, it carried Hard-Hitting News tags for many turns (flatline risk) and installed Daily Casts on T3 while tagged, which the Corp then trashed.

Played Audacity on T1 with nothing installed, which trashed Project Atlas and two Hostile Takeovers into an open Archives for the Runner to steal on T1. Then spent 2 clicks on T5 to Consulting Visit an Economic Warfare it could not play, lost a GFI from HQ behind one Hortum, and fell to 0 credits.

Solid tempo: Forged Activation Orders, then Priority Requisition stolen twice from Server 1 and the winning steal of Private Security Force. Minor inefficiency: whole turns clicking for credits (T4, T7) and 10 credits spent breaking Archer for a single R&D access.

Repeated R&D runs on T1-3 kept re-seeing the same top card, and from T4 to T10 it mostly clicked for credits (up to 18). It never ran the naked Servers 2, 3 and 6 or contested the Server 1/4 agendas, installed Atman with 0 counters (T6), and bounced off Ice Wall once while Gila Hands was scored.

Remote scoring worked, but R&D stayed behind a lone Pop-up Window all game while the Runner ran it every turn and stole four agendas (T7-T9). Biotic Labor on T3 was spent on a draw and click-for-credits.

Clean plan: IPO economy, then SDS Drone Deployment (which trashed Black Orchestra), a second SDS and SSL Endorsement, each scored behind Surveyor-backed remotes. T7 shows only an IPO with no other actions.

Won against a passive Runner, but spent its last 3 credits on Hard-Hitting News on T3 with no follow-up, sat at 0-4 credits until T11, and left R&D and HQ unprotected for 10+ turns while clicking for credits and discarding.

Good: Stimhack plus Paperclip stole Hostile Takeover on T1, Hippo killed a 15-credit Orion on T6, D4v1d was used to steal SDS, and HQ yielded SSL for the win. Economy was thin early with stacked Daily Casts.

Three times it installed agendas behind three unrezzed ice while holding 1 credit: Project Beale (T3), Bellona (T4) and Bellona again (T14 after spending 6 credits on T13 to trash Liberated Account). The Runner walked through each time. Psychographics did nothing on T9, and it clicked for credits while discarding at 13-16 credits.

From T1 to T8 it ran R&D 4 times a turn, re-accessing the same top card, at 1 credit and with no economy. It never contested Server 1 or 3 where Offworld Office and Project Atlas were scored, and it left the 4 Hard-Hitting News tags (T5) until High-Profile Target hit for 4 on T11.

Sensible R&D/HQ pressure with Temujin and Corroder won, but slowly: after facechecking Quandary on the 4-ice Server 1 (T6) it let three Project Beales score there uncontested. Clone Chip did nothing for several turns, and the game dragged to T19.

Audacity on T3 trashed GFI and Offworld Office into an unprotected Archives, and they were stolen on T4. Project Atlas went into Server 4 behind a single Mausolus and was stolen on T5. It then spent T6-T8 trashing Daily Casts and Aeneas Informant over and over while R&D and HQ stayed thin.

Correctly hammered the Pop-up Window-only HQ for three agendas and the win. The T1 Account Siphon was lost to Pop-up Window after spending down on Eater, and the T2 HQ run with no spare credits was wasted.

Send a Message was left in Server 1 behind only Mlinzi at 2 credits (stolen T8). A second Send a Message (T10) and Obokata (T18) sat in an HQ guarded by one Anemone. Divert Power on T12 derezzed all its own ice, and T9-T16 were mostly click-for-credits with end-of-turn discards.

Fast-scored Project Beale with Biotic Labor and later won, but twice put agendas in Server 5 behind a lone Quandary against a 30-credit Runner holding Houdini (Project Beale stolen T10, GFI stolen T12). Sensie Actors Union draws caused repeated discards.

From T1 to T5 it ran R&D repeatedly at 0 credits, re-seeing the same top card, while GFI was advanced in Server 1 and never challenged. At 13-15 credits on T7-8 it drew and clicked for credits instead of contesting the GFI that was then scored with Audacity.
